intro: The Clermont recliner is your private theatre at home. With noiseless reclining, leather-touch upholstery, and an embedded coffee table, it’s built for indulgent relaxation and cinematic comfort.

features.title: Leather upholstery for a premium touch
features.text: Upholstered with a mix of composite leather and pure leather touchpoints, the Clermont recliner combines luxurious aesthetics with everyday practicality.

features.title: Reclining made smooth and effortless
features.text: The manual reclining mechanism adjusts up to 140 degrees, letting you find your ideal position for ultimate relaxation at the touch of a lever.

features.title: High backrest for head and spine support
features.text: The tall backrest provides full support to your head and spine, making this recliner the perfect choice for movie nights or relaxation.

features.title: Armrests designed for complete comfort
features.text: Reclon-filled armrests cradle your arms gently, giving you the ergonomic support you need for long sitting or lounging sessions.

features.title: A built-in coffee table for convenience
features.text: The embedded MDF coffee table adds functionality, giving you a handy space to keep drinks, snacks, or books close by while you unwind.

name: Clermont 3-Seater Leatherette Recliner
